description:
I built a $350 budget gaming PC using used eBay parts, and it performs way better than it has any right to! Here's how I turned a basic Lenovo office desktop into a legitimate 1080p gaming beast without spending an arm and a leg.

Buy an ideaCenter 5 on eBay: https://ebay.us/V1Jyh4
eBay RTX 3050 6GB: https://ebay.us/Up50wo

Can you actually build a capable gaming PC for under $400 right now? Absolutely. In this video, I take a used Lenovo IdeaCentre 5 (14IMB05) featuring an Intel Core i5-10400 and upgrade it for serious budget gaming. By adding 16GB of DDR4 RAM and an Nvidia GeForce RTX 3050 6GB Low Profile GPU, we easily bypass the limitations of the stock 260W power supply—no extra PCIe power cables required!
